text:
Situation: Our formulary olanzapine 10 mg tablets (NDC 33342008411) are manufactured by Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3007517881). Current inventory across three sites ranges from 12 to 29 days on hand. Corvale East has 190 tablets (24 days), Corvale General has 229.24 tablets (28.8 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 15 tablets (11.7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1032020 ended 2017-11-24 and was classified OAI with nine observations including absent written procedures and inadequate laboratory controls. FDA inspection 1157334 ended 2021-11-01 and was also classified OAI. The most recent inspection 1220834 ended 2023-10-20 and returned to VAI classification. Since 2022, three recalls have been initiated for Macleods olanzapine tablets: a Class II recall in 2022 for cGMP deviations, a Class II recall in 2024 for failed impurity specifications, and a Class III recall in 2026 for organic and unspecified impurities above specification. Olanzapine is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is constrained due to the manufacturer's quality history and recent recalls, though no national shortage is declared. Inventory at Corvale Lakeside is critically low.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Alkermes, Inc. (requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition).
2. Buyer to qualify and purchase from American Health Packaging (requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition).
3. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee, LLC (requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition).
4. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Apotex Corp. (requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition).
5. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Ascend Laboratories, LLC (requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
